---
title: "IDV SDK"
description: "Integrate document capture and identity verification."
---

`@bouncrlabs/idv` captures identity documents and submits them to Bouncr for verification.

Create a scan on your backend, initialize the SDK with its session token, and retrieve the scan after processing completes.
